purpose: Evaluate a faithful full-frame native-resolution SPAI path before considering calibration or production integration. The prior center-crop adapter is preserved as a separate limited experiment.

phase1.sampling: 8 uniform frames; same times as prior adapter
phase1.aggregation: mean raw frame logit; initial threshold0; scores are not probabilities
phase1.comparison: Paired old cropped versus new full-frame model path, default threshold, ranking AUROC, frame and clip scores, failures, latency, pixel and patch coverage.

followups: Only if corrected inference supplies a credible development signal, evaluate the preexisting70development derivatives and6CGI/mixed controls with unchanged configuration. Freeze any later candidate and threshold before using a new untouched evaluation set.
guardrails: No app/prompt/scorer changes during this study.
Do not use consumed75clip holdout or its derivatives for selection/tuning.
All development variants stay grouped by parent media identity; these identities do not establish semantic source independence.
Do not infer deployment probabilities or general accuracy from development results.
Any production claim requires improved recall with controlled false positives, robustness to reposts and controls, and better-grounded test origins.
